content: Xeime tawarita 'inɨari mariweme nekaniuxeiya muyuawitsie tiyɨhɨxiyatsitɨwame: 'atahuta niuki tuayamete nekaniwaruxeiya 'atahutame kwiniyayari memexeiyakai 'imatɨrieka miemete, mɨkɨkɨ Kakaɨyari haxɨaya memaye'atɨanikɨ.

Yaxeikɨata haramara xikɨri mutitatawe hepaɨ 'anekame nekaniuxeiya. Mɨkɨ meta nepɨwaruxei haramara tetsita me'uti'ukame yeutanaka mema'iwaxɨ, 'ɨkiyari meta 'inɨariyari kemɨtitewa. Haripa mekaniu'ɨkaitɨ Kakaɨyari mɨwayetuiriekai,
meta Muitsexi nɨawarieya mekwikatɨ Kakaɨyari ti'uximayatsiriwame, meta Muxa nɨawarieya:
Mɨya tiuyɨku mɨpaɨta nekatiniuniere, muyuawitsie tuki muwe kaneuyepiere, hakewa Kakaɨyari mehekɨatsie.
Muwa tukita mekanayenexɨani niuki tuayamete 'atahutatɨ memi'atɨa 'atahuta kwiniyayari. Rinu 'ixurikiyari mɨ'itiya mepanakatɨtɨkatei xawatɨmekɨ, meta huru hɨiyameyarikɨ yutawitsie mepayuhɨatɨkatei.
Hikɨ yunaukatɨ memayeneniere, xewitɨ mɨkɨ kaniwarutahapatɨani niuki tuayamete xexuime huru kupayari Kakaɨyari haxɨaya hɨpɨneme, yuheyemekɨ mayeniere tsepanetɨ xeitsienituyari wiyari manuyekɨka.
Hikɨ tukita kɨtsi kaniuyehɨne, Kakaɨyari xawatɨriyaya meta kemɨtitɨrɨkaɨye, xewitɨ pɨkayɨwekai tukita meutahanikɨ kepaukake meutipare 'atahuta kwiniyayari, 'atahutatɨ niuki tuayamete memi'atɨa.
